narrative.intro: JT4 has obligated $376M in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. JT4 recorded 1 award this fiscal year, making the average award size $376M. Obligations fell 5.6% year over year. JT4's obligations have ranged across the last six fiscal years: $322M in FY21, $325M in FY22, $391M in FY23, $385M in FY24, $398M in FY25, and $376M in FY26. The current-year total is a fiscal year to date figure and contract obligations are the reported measure except for award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Readers should note the concentration of this year’s dollars into a single award and the recent pattern of fiscal-year totals, including a peak at $398M in FY25 followed by the FY26 total of $376M. The single-award count and the average award size equal $376M, which highlights the importance of award-level detail when assessing JT4's federal revenue profile.
